desc:
Welcome to ORA!
Dance your way to the top of the pyramid! Here you can create unique dances, roleplay with friends, build and attend competitions, and meet other dancers who share your passion. We have over 600+ moves with more coming soon…
─────
➛ We are inspired by Dance Moms and ALDC, bringing the energy of competitive dance to life in a virtual world and helping others learn grow and thrive within the dance community! 
─────
➛ Enhance your experience with our various exclusive items such as private servers with mod commands and gamepasses containing new items, controls!
─────
